_comment: Methodology constants from research/batch1/02_methodology.md §7. Each triple is [P5, P50, P95] treated as lognormal. methodology_version bumps on any formula change.
_u_fleet_note: Fleet-median utilization factor converting benchmark throughput-batched eta to fleet-median reality. Batch-4 recalibration: Oviedo/ML.ENERGY triangulation implies 1.3-1.6 ex-overhead; Oviedo beta=1.31; Google fleet idle only +14%; batch curves cap at 2-5x (TokenPowerBench, Caravaca 36x only at batch-1 extreme). Default = hyperscaler-class 1.5 [1.0,3.0]; independents override to [1.2,1.8,3.2] in provider_profiles. NOT applied to sram_dataflow rows.
_lambda_think_note: NOT applied in factors; factors are per billed/visible token. Apply lambda_think at estimate time only when a provider hides thinking tokens AND the request used reasoning.
_k_moe_note: MoE kernel/routing overhead on active-param basis: ACL 2025 (arXiv:2504.17674) measured +54% at similar active params; tempered by modern MoE on Blackwell (Qwen3-A22B -82% case).
